contentPattern.structure: heading + subheading + paragraph | single side image

suitableFor: informational page intros with a single supporting image beside heading + intro copy
notSuitableFor: landing hero sections needing an image cluster and CTAs (use hero-gallery)
dark full-bleed CTA banners with a background image (use hero-overlay)
article mastheads with breadcrumbs/byline/date/category metadata (use hero-article)
